lead: Make useful words part of your everyday vocabulary. Explore a dictionary, build your own practice, and return to what needs another look.
access: Access is by invitation. Already have access?
discoverBody: Explore Dilum Nederlands, our own Dutch learning dictionary, with meanings, word forms, examples and usage notes. Choose the vocabulary you want to make your own.
practiceBody: Choose your material and exercises. Build a session around what you want to learn, rather than making every card yourself.
rememberBody: Bring new words and reviews together with spaced repetition. Keep your learning progress as you return to practise.
builderBody: Pick a language and a source. Choose your exercises, narrow the focus, and decide how much to take on today.
builderMore: The session builder brings these choices together, so you can spend your time learning.
contextBody: Meet words with their definitions and examples. Reveal the answer when you are ready, then continue at your own pace.
contextMore: Your dictionary and your practice belong to the same learning routine.
supportEyebrow: Stay in the language. Get help in yours.
supportBody: Learn from definitions and examples in the language you’re studying. When you need support, AI-powered translations can help you understand them in your chosen language — with an optional second translation language alongside it.
supportCaution: Use the translation as support, then return to the original. AI translations can make mistakes.
plannedBody: create your own dictionary entries directly in 2000nl, manually or with AI assistance.
audiofilmsBody: We’re exploring a learning layer for YouTube: repeat a phrase, show its translation, and click a word to open its dictionary card. The test prototype connects to 2000nl so useful words can become part of your practice.
pontixBody: , for looking up words as you read in your browser.
faqAccessFirst: Access is currently by invitation. If you already have an account,
faqAccessLast: . Otherwise, join the waiting list above for access updates.
faqLanguagesBody: Dutch is the first learning dictionary featured here. Tell us which language interests you when you join; other languages and connected workflows are being developed.
faqTestingTitle: Do I have to test early versions?
faqTestingBody: No. Testing is an optional choice on the form. Joining the waiting list does not create an account or a paid subscription.
